# W3Schools

> W3Schools is a comprehensive online learning platform offering tutorials, documentation, and video courses for web development and programming languages.

W3Schools provides free and paid educational content covering core web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), server-side languages (PHP, Python, Java), databases (SQL, MySQL), and modern frameworks (React, Bootstrap). The platform serves as both a tutorial portal and reference resource for developers of all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- SQL
- Python
- PHP
- Java
- W3.CSS
- Bootstrap
- React
- MySQL
- Web Development
- Responsive Design
- Front-end Development
- Programming Languages

## Core Web Technologies

- [W3Schools Online Web Tutorials](https://www.w3schools.com): W3Schools homepage: online tutorial portal for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL and foundational web development

## CSS Frameworks & Libraries

- [W3.CSS Home](https://www.w3schools.com/w3css/default.asp): W3.CSS framework home: responsive CSS library for modern web development

## Video Learning Resources

- [Video Tutorials - W3Schools](https://www.w3schools.com/videos/index.php): Video tutorial index covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL and web development fundamentals
- [HTML VIDEOS](https://videos-stage.w3schools.com/): HTML video course: paid beginner-friendly video content for learning HTML
